# Fixture: `bad_marked_user_sync_src_flop`

<!-- generator: scripts/gen_fixture_docs.py -->

Trust-boundary sentinel (issue #178): `(* cdc_sync *)` placed on the SOURCE-side producer flop, not the destination sync first stage. The attribute should be a no-op for CDC-001 suppression — the rule looks for the marker on the *destination* flop of a crossing (`c.dst_flop.cell.name in ctx.user_syncs`).

Structurally a 1FF "chain": src_q → dst_q with no second stage in dst_clk. CDC-001 must still fire on dst_q despite the (mis-placed) attribute on src_q.
